source.title: The Bloody Missive
source.description: You find a missive on the body of the "paladin". It is covered in blood and difficult to read, but you can make out the message on the parchment. You should study it and then return to Katherine for further instructions.
source.objective: Bring the missive to Katherine the Pure at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
source.progress: So it was a trap... this is most troubling.
source.completion:
It's a blessing that you are safe, <name>.  I am hoping that wherever Aeonas went, he does not fall into similar danger. He is resourceful so I have to trust that he will be okay. If I hear anything from him, I will contact you immediately. Thank you, <name>.

Oh and one last thing. He entrusted this to me to pass onto you whenever you returned. Use it well and go with the light.
